title: Drinking Water Contaminants
description: Chemistry in water with a focus on metals or other contaminants, drinking water treatment technologies, toxicology, materials flow and life-cycle thinking, regulations, and an understanding of function in an industrial process.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CIVE 448, CIVE 480B (if taken in the same topic), CIVE 548.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
